# 山遥 · Mont Away

> 山遥是一个发现和分享小众旅行地点、徒步与骑行路线、地图游记、图片和视频的社区。
> Mont Away is a community for discovering and sharing lesser-known travel places, walking and cycling routes, map stories, photos and videos.

Canonical site: https://sy.chexi.tech/
Chinese: https://sy.chexi.tech/
English: https://sy.chexi.tech/en/

## Public sections

- Home / 首页: https://sy.chexi.tech/
- Map discovery / 地图发现: https://sy.chexi.tech/map
- Popular stories / 热门游记: https://sy.chexi.tech/ranking

## Content notes

- Public posts contain traveler-authored titles, descriptions, places, route stops and media.
- Place pages aggregate public stories for a geographic place.
- Private account, administration, messaging and publishing pages should not be indexed.
- API responses are available under `/api/v1/`, but public website pages are the preferred citation targets.
